Usage: upbrr serve [options]

Options:

Config:
  -config, --config string
      Path to config file

Server:
  -addr, --addr string
      Web UI listen address (host:port)
  -host, --host string
      Web UI host to bind
  -port, --port int
      Web UI port to bind
  -base-url, --base-url string
      External Web UI base URL or path, for example https://example.test/upbrr/ or /upbrr/
  -persist-listen, --persist-listen
      Persist Web UI listen host and port to web-config.json
  -persist-web-config, --persist-web-config
      Persist supplied Web UI serve settings to web-config.json

Development:
  -dev-no-auth, --dev-no-auth
      Development only: serve web UI without web authentication on loopback hosts
